The V pipe's in-order execution already completes the preceding Add before the SetFlag is processed, matching this function's own RMS loop where ReduceSum -> SetFlag has no PipeBarrier. The V->V barriers (Muls->Mul, Mul->Add) are unchanged. No arithmetic, store, dispatch, or tile-constant change.
